cauchy_stress_observable.rationale: The visualization UMAT operates as a non-load-bearing diagnostic layer (tangent DDSDDE = 1e-11, S = 0). Mechanical equilibrium is solved exclusively by UEL Layers 1 and 2. Continuum element output requests on user elements produce benign informational warnings. Physical fracture validation observables are completely governed by RF2, U2, phase-field damage d (SDV1), history H (SDV2), and crack geometry.

step_1.name: Step-1
step_1.assessment: Strictly pre-critical. Confines damage nucleation to notch root without premature macrocrack localization.

step_2.name: Step-2
step_2.assessment: Highly conservative initial increment (0.014 um per inc) allows fine resolution of peak force and gradual softening initiation. Automatic cutbacks down to 1.0e-8 enable robust negotiation of local snap-through / softening instability without premature solver divergence.

hpc_audit.parallel_safety_rationale: Per repository governance in AGENTS.md, f42_mixed_uel.for is NOT qualified for multi-rank MPI (MULTI_RANK_MPI_STRICTLY_DISQUALIFIED). Single-rank shared-memory SMP (8 threads) is empirically qualified and shares Fortran COMMON blocks safely across threads. 1-CPU serial serves as the authoritative reference anchor if threading race conditions occur.

scientific_checks.name: Numerical Convergence
scientific_checks.criterion: Both Step-1 and Step-2 complete without solver crash, non-finite arithmetic, or zero cutback termination.

scientific_checks.name: Load-Displacement Physical Response
scientific_checks.criterion: Reaction force curve shows linear elastic stiffness, smooth peak near 0.007–0.008 mm, followed by progressive softening drop.

scientific_checks.name: Phase-Field Physical Bounds
scientific_checks.criterion: 0.0 <= d <= 1.0 strictly maintained across all 23,965 physical elements at all converged increments.

scientific_checks.name: Damage Irreversibility
scientific_checks.criterion: dot(d) >= 0 and H_{n+1} >= H_n strictly maintained; zero healing or negative damage evolution.

scientific_checks.name: Crack Path & Hole Interaction
scientific_checks.criterion: Crack initiates at notch tip (0.50, 0.50) mm and propagates towards the off-axis hole, evaluating qualitative deflection against Pandey & Kumar (2025).

scientific_checks.name: Thermodynamic Energy Monotonicity
scientific_checks.criterion: Integrated fracture energy E_frac increases monotonically with crack advance.
